title: Req-Space: A User Study of Interactive Visualisations for Requirements Review
abstract: arXiv:2611.05437v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Requirements review involves identifying inconsistencies and assessing change implications across distributed specifications. Motivated by needs raised in industrial project workshops, we investigate Req-Space, an interactive prototype integrating semantic exploration and traceability visualisation to support human-led review. We conducted a fixed-order, two-phase study with 20 participants, including 11 with at least three years of software or IT experience. Participants reviewed a fictional 40-requirement software specification and a guest-checkout change request, first using source documents and then revisiting the same tasks with Req-Space. During the supported review, 17 participants recorded at least one additional source-supported item or pair. translated_title: Req-Space：面向需求评审的交互式可视化用户研究
translated_abstract: 需求评审涉及识别分布式规格说明中的不一致性，并评估变更的影响。受工业项目研讨会中提出的实际需求的启发，我们研究了Req-Space——一个集成语义探索与可追溯性可视化的交互式原型，旨在支持以人为主导的评审。我们开展了一项固定顺序的两阶段研究，共有20名参与者，其中11名拥有至少三年软件或IT领域经验。参与者需要评审一份虚构的包含40项需求的软件规格说明以及一个访客结账功能的变更请求，首先仅使用源文档完成评审，随后借助Req-Space重新执行相同任务。在得到工具支持的评审阶段，17名参与者记录了至少一个额外的有源文档支持的条目或需求配对。在69个可评估的额外发现中，有58个（84.1%）被判定确实获得了源材料的支持。有七条决策理由在第二阶段被评定为更加有力，其中包括五条在未发生变更的情况下……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出Req-Space交互式原型，通过集成语义探索与可追溯性可视化来辅助需求评审，用户研究表明该工具能帮助评审者发现更多有源文档支持的额外问题并强化决策理由。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Req-Space, an interactive prototype integrating semantic exploration and traceability visualisation for requirements review, and a user study showing it helps reviewers uncover additional source-supported items and strengthen their decision rationales.
